listing.name: Conan (2007) — Conan2007Recomp (crazyriddler)
listing.summary: The project describes a Direct3D 12 player. It requires a controller and has physics defects at high frame rates. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Conan (2007) Xbox 360 complete extracted game files, including the original executable. This guide does not specify the exact supported region, revision or file hash. Check the project’s original-file requirements before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: The project describes putting your own extracted Conan data in Data. This guide does not establish complete public build or player-setup instructions.
